LanguageData.LP_Feat_PracticedHand.label: learning by doing
LanguageData.LP_Feat_PracticedHand.description: Work is training too. Adventurer XP converted from daily work ×1.5; the daily full-credit portion rises from 80 to 120 (after that still counted at half). Grants +1 Wisdom or Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MasterArtisan.label: master artisan
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MasterArtisan.description: From a master's hands. Every item you craft has a 30% chance to go up one quality tier (up to legendary); making a masterwork or legendary piece gives mood +4 "proud work" for 1 day. Requires Dexterity or Intelligence 13. Grants +1 Dexterity or Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_RuneSmith.label: rune smith
LanguageData.LP_Feat_RuneSmith.description: Every hammer stroke has its method. Work speed ×1.4 at the rune anvil; items made on the rune anvil have a 25% chance to go up one quality tier (only the higher chance of this and Master Artisan counts, one tier only); each completed item has a 20% chance to refund a quarter of the metal. Requires Strength or Intelligence 13. Grants +1 Strength or Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MasterAlchemist.label: master alchemist
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MasterAlchemist.description: Heat and proportions, exact to the grain. Work speed ×1.35 at the alchemy table; products made at the alchemy table have a 30% chance of an extra unit (based on the recipe's first product). Requires Crafting or Medicine 6. Grants +1 Intelligence or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MasterBuilder.label: master builder
LanguageData.LP_Feat_MasterBuilder.description: Every brick laid solid. Construction speed ×1.35, construction success +15%; construction speed another ×1.5 when repairing buildings. Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_GreenThumb.label: hand of harvest
LanguageData.LP_Feat_GreenThumb.description: Every crop you touch grows well. Plant work speed ×1.3, harvest yield +15%; gains the active ability "Quicken growth" (once per day, restored at midnight): all plants within 6 cells of you gain +20% growth (up to mature). Grants +1 Wisdom or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Surgeon.label: master surgeon
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Surgeon.description: Never makes a big mistake with the knife. Surgery success ×1.25 (stacks with Healer, still subject to the vanilla cap), surgery speed ×1.5; failed surgeries are never fatal or catastrophic, at worst a minor failure. Requires Dexterity 13. Grants +1 Dexterity or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Fabricate.label: hands of creation
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Fabricate.description: A thought, and the object takes shape. Gains the active ability "Fabricate" (once per day, restored at midnight): press while crafting at a workbench to instantly finish half the remaining work (up to the equivalent of 60000 work), and this piece's quality is at least "excellent" (the effect lasts 1 day and applies to the next piece finished). Requires Master Artisan. Grants +1 Intelligence.
